symbols.name: indicator vector
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector of the triple T: entry 1 at each position of T, entry 0 elsewhere.
symbols.quote: The indicator vector $t_T$ has entry $1$ at each position $e \in T$, where $e$ is an element of $[h]$, and entry $0$ elsewhere.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A single three-element subset of [h], one of the two triples in a neighbor pair.
symbols.quote: Here $S$ and $T$ name triples; $T$ changes meaning from the ground-set page.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A single three-element subset of [h]; on the ground-set page T names all triples.
symbols.quote: Here $S$ and $T$ name triples; $T$ changes meaning from the ground-set page.

symbols.name: position
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set [h], a position of the indicator vector.
symbols.quote: The indicator vector $t_T$ has entry $1$ at each position $e \in T$, where $e$ is an element of $[h]$, and entry $0$ elsewhere.

symbols.name: all-ones matrix
symbols.meaning: The h by h matrix whose entries are all 1.
symbols.quote: Let $J$ be the $h\times h$ matrix of all ones.

symbols.name: rational numbers
symbols.meaning: The field of rational numbers; Q^h is the set of h-tuples of them.
symbols.quote: In the bit construction the form lives on $\mathbb{Q}^h$, the $h$-tuples of rational numbers:

relations.quote: An indicator vector is a 0-1 vector that is indexed by the elements of a [Ground set](ground-set.md) and marks which belong to a given subset.
An indicator vector is compared with others by the [bilinear form](bilinear-form.md) of each construction.
